faq.q: The page mentions RF-12c and RF-13 coach-home zoning — is that current?
faq.a: No — those are pre-2024 zone names. Surrey's July 8, 2024 SSMUH changes replaced RF-12, RF-12C and RF-13 with the R4 Small Lot Residential Zone; a coach house or garden suite today runs 35–75 m² (up to 120 m² on RA, R2, R2-O and R3 lots below maximum FAR), with lane access required for a coach house on smaller lots.
